The Office of Strategic Management (OSM) works closely with the C\-suite and with senior leaders in each of the businesses on the bank’s top strategic priorities, spanning the end\-to\-end lifecycle –from strategy development and solution prioritization all the way through to implementation.


The OSM brings together the development and execution of BMO’s overall strategy by deeply integrating strategy and performance management within each business, enabled by strong connectivity of the team to the Operating Group Heads and their leadership teams, Finance, Technology \& Operations, and Corporate Functions.

jobs.description:
Translational Research in Oncology (TRIO) is a global academic clinical research organization dedicated to advancing translational cancer research in the clinical trial setting. Our passionate team is committed to providing cancer treatments of the future to the world of today.


TRIO is looking for a **Senior Director, Quality Assurance** to join ourQuality Assurance team. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer (**CEO**)withkey working relationships are maintained with all TRIO departments. This position will be **remote** based in **Canada, France, Germany, or Spain.**

**Overview:**

**Lead global quality. Advise senior leaders. Drive continuous improvement.**


As TRIO’s Senior Director, Quality Assurance, you will report directly to the CEO and lead the global Quality Assurance function, providing independent oversight of clinical research activities. You will oversee the CQA team and CSV Unit Manager while partnering across TRIO to strengthen quality and drive continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Quality leadership:** Set global, risk\-based QA priorities aligned with organizational and regulatory requirements; escalate significant or systemic risks to the CEO and senior leadership.
* **QMS governance:** Oversee policies, SOPs, controlled documents, deviations, change control, risk management, and corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to maintain an effective QMS.
* **Audits and inspections:** Direct risk\-based audits of trials, sites, processes, and vendors. Serve as the primary audit and inspection contact, oversee responses and timely commitments, and maintain QA independence.
* **Clinical quality:** Oversee quality throughout the trial lifecycle, advise on Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and procedures, and guide investigations, root\-cause analyses, and remediation.
* **Continuous improvement:** Track quality indicators and emerging risks, recommend improvements, and support management review and regulatory and quality\-system changes.
* **Data protection:** Serve as the internal privacy contact, liaise with the external Data Protection Officer, and oversee compliance with applicable privacy laws.
* **Team and Systems:** Lead QA planning, resourcing, mentoring, and cross\-departmental training; own EQMS and related systems; and serve as Department Disaster Recovery Leader.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, healthcare, quality, or related discipline.
* At least 10 years of progressive clinical research, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO experience, including at least 10 years in significant QA/GCP compliance roles.
* Experience leading or overseeing a **GCP** QMS, clinical QA audits, CAPAs, investigations, vendor oversight, and regulatory inspection and sponsor/client audit readiness.
* People\-management and functional leadership experience; ability to advise senior leaders and collaborate across departments.
* Strong knowledge of ICH GCP, FDA requirements, and EU regulations; knowledge of computerized system validation principles.
